This successor of har-40-cloud-worker-bundle-r8 binds cloud-release-r46 (profile sha256 fb8b9a568f4b9d082a353d2fa0a7b9ea466dad61d1fe3ac26e0ea7bac17b5d29), derived by the repository tooling at 59d9036cdf2846081157a71e99da89fab2b2b4bf. The bundle is 91135 bytes with sha256 34a474f445a5b2d4f494e44db2fa480e8d482fa764e5f76f09d35a6351a1668f; the input closure is 19 files and the emitted closure 18. The proof bundle is a separate sealed member of the candidate and has no release profile of its own.
